text: Cooling Tower Constructions & Repair In Thailand The convenient geography of our service from our Thailand office allows us to dispatch service personnel from here to any location in Asia within hours and the Middle East within a day. Contact Us Things to Consider When Finding A Cooling Tower Manufacturer At ICS, we know that manufacturing cooling tower systems is a major undertaking, so we encourage prospective clients to do their due diligence before settling on a manufacturer. These are some of the most important points of contention to examine when researching potential partners: Design A water cooling tower is an important tool for any industrial facility, but it must be designed for optimal thermal efficiency and minimum power consumption. Not all designs are as intelligent as they seem; a manufacturer should be able to discuss what sets their designs apart in great detail and prove their design meets the owner’s specification as well as CTI Standards. Supply Without a proper supply chain, a manufacturer will never be able to meet your needs, no matter how flawless their designs may be. When it comes to cooling solutions, many companies simply can’t wait months for the proper parts to come in. Installation Make sure that a manufacturer knows how to do more than just dream up effective solutions; they should also be able to implement them in your plant environment. This will allow for a more seamless experience from start to finish. Servicing Without fail, a water-cooling tower will eventually need to be serviced, and if the manufacturer can handle that for you, then it will be all the better. A manufacturer that sells parts in addition to whole solutions is most desirable. What Does the Process Look Like? After expressing interest in constructing a new cooling tower, you might be surprised to learn just how easy Industrial Cooling Solutions (ICS) will make to bring your requirements to life. Our technology is not just advanced in terms of performance, but also in terms of eco-friendliness. We are committed to upholding standards of value, service, quality, and integrity in everything that we do. If you are interested in exploring a cooling tower solution that is powerful yet environmentally conscious, contact us today! Why Do We Stand Out? With years of extensive experience in the industry, we have a team of highly skilled professionals who can provide you with the best possible cooling tower services. We use the latest technology and equipment to ensure that your cooling tower is built to last. Some of the perks include: Uniquely Designed Our cooling towers are designed to save energy and money with variable-speed drives. Energy Efficient Our cooling towers are energy efficient, saving you money on your energy bill. The units use less water and electricity, which helps reduce your carbon footprint. Low Maintenance Our cooling towers are built with corrosion-resistant materials that require little to no maintenance. Long-Lasting Our cooling towers are built to last with high-quality materials that can withstand the elements. The units are also backed by warranty, ensuring you of their quality and durability. Contact Us FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions) What’s The Cost? Providing an accurate cost estimate is difficult without knowing the specific details of your project. The size, height, and location of your cooling tower will all factor into the final price. You can contact us for a free quote based on your specific needs. How Long Will The Project Take? It will depend on the size and scope of your project. We always aim to complete projects as quickly and efficiently as possible without sacrificing quality. Also, keep in mind that inclement weather can sometimes delay construction. Is Maintenance Required? Yes, all cooling towers require some level of maintenance. Depending on the tower type, this can range from regular cleaning and inspections to more extensive repairs. Our team can help you develop a maintenance plan that fits your needs.

Things to Consider When Finding A Cooling Tower Manufacturer

At ICS, we know that manufacturing cooling tower systems is a major undertaking, so we encourage prospective clients to do their due diligence before settling on a manufacturer. These are some of the most important points of contention to examine when researching potential partners:

A water cooling tower is an important tool for any industrial facility, but it must be designed for optimal thermal efficiency and minimum power consumption. Not all designs are as intelligent as they seem; a manufacturer should be able to discuss what sets their designs apart in great detail and prove their design meets the owner’s specification as well as CTI Standards.

Without a proper supply chain, a manufacturer will never be able to meet your needs, no matter how flawless their designs may be. When it comes to cooling solutions, many companies simply can’t wait months for the proper parts to come in.

Make sure that a manufacturer knows how to do more than just dream up effective solutions; they should also be able to implement them in your plant environment. This will allow for a more seamless experience from start to finish.

Without fail, a water-cooling tower will eventually need to be serviced, and if the manufacturer can handle that for you, then it will be all the better. A manufacturer that sells parts in addition to whole solutions is most desirable.
What Does the Process Look Like?

After expressing interest in constructing a new cooling tower, you might be surprised to learn just how easy Industrial Cooling Solutions (ICS) will make to bring your requirements to life. The experience will unfold essentially in this order:

At that point, we can begin shipping the material to the site
Finally, we can then begin work constructing the tower
